name: fernly-shop-practicum
description: Fernly, a small houseplant shop for practicing component, UI, API, end-to-end and accessibility testing with AI agents.

scripts.start: concurrently -k -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm run start -w api" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w api && npm run typecheck -w web
